title: Facebook Ads for Pet Grooming: Examples & Strategy | GetHookd

facts.fact: The GetHookd vendor page states it covers 22 million live Meta ads, and the library is described as updated daily.
According to the GetHookd vendor page, the tool is trusted by more than 100,000 users.
The article recommends setting the Facebook ad targeting radius around a pet grooming salon to 10–20 miles, depending on market density.
facts.quote: Set your radius to 10–20 miles, depending on your market density.

facts.fact: The article recommends a time-lapse grooming transformation video ad of 15–30 seconds.
facts.quote: Shoot a 15–30 second clip that condenses an entire grooming session

facts.fact: The article advises filming the time-lapse grooming video at 4x or 8x speed.
facts.quote: Film at 4x or 8x speed, add upbeat royalty-free music

facts.fact: The article suggests offering clients a 10% discount on their next visit in exchange for tagging the business in post-grooming photos for user-generated content.
facts.quote: asking clients to tag your business in their post-grooming photos in exchange for a small incentive, like 10% off their next visit.

facts.fact: According to the GetHookd page, the tool connects to AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, or Perplexity in about 30 seconds.
facts.quote: Connect GetHookd to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor or Perplexity in about 30 seconds, no code needed.

facts.fact: The article was published on July 25, 2026.
The page advises letting a Facebook campaign run for at least 7 days before making adjustments.
facts.quote: let the campaign run for at least 7 days before making adjustments.

facts.fact: The page advises giving campaigns at least 7 days to optimize before making changes.
facts.quote: Give campaigns at least 7 days to optimize before making changes

facts.fact: GetHookd states it gives access to 65M+ high-performing ads on Meta and TikTok (vendor's own claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: across 65M+ high-performing ads on Meta and TikTok.

facts.fact: The page suggests targeting pet owners within a 10–20-mile radius of the salon for local Facebook and Instagram ads.
facts.quote: Target pet owners within a 10–20-mile radius of your salon
